player_prompt.intro:
Kei te takaro koe i Slitherlink ki runga i te {R}x{C} whārangi!
Tīe he niho kotahi tonu kia rite ngā koata numera ki te maha o ngā āhuatanga e pā ana.
Whakapapa ngā āhuatanga ki:
  [h r c] - whakapapa āhuatanga horizontals ki runga ake i ngā tumu ki raro r, ki kolumo c
  [v r c] - whakapapa āhuatanga vertikals ki mauī o ngā tumu ki raro r, ki kolumo c
Ngā numera whakaatu ki te maha o ngā āhuatanga e tono ana, '.' he tohutohu kahore.
Kei a koe ki runga i {max_turns} nekehanga ki te whakataki i te tangaro.

invalid_move.wrong_format: He huaketo huaketo whakaputa. Whakamahia [h row col] atau [v row col].
invalid_move.out_of_bounds: Te pito i waho o te papa.

outcome.win: Kua hanga e koe he porowhita kotahi! Ka whakaotihia te pākihi!
outcome.turn_limit: Kua tae ki te rohe nekehanga. Kāore i oti te papakupu.
